summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without committing or running any repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the ESC ]0;title BEL format entry and the Control.title classmethod with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True when written and False when not a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control_title, and a Windows-only renderer test asserting set_title is called once with "Hello, world!". Nothing was run, and Black formatting was checked only by line length reading.
